question: Which office of an organization may claim a purchased ICRA assessment into the tenant, must that office be the purchaser, and what does each paid report tier deliver once claimed?
decision: Only an organization officer/admin expressly authorized for purchasing may claim an assessment via a single-use, short-lived claim token bound to purchaser and verified org; email receipt alone is not sufficient authority. Paid tier promises must exactly match delivered, independently verified report artifacts. Remove unimplemented executive-PDF claims; claim attempts and transfers are audited.
originalProposedDecision: Only an admin or officer of the org may claim, using a claim token issued to the purchaser's email at checkout. Tier deliverables are exactly what the report route releases; remove the executive PDF promise until it exists.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
